name: Santé brake calipers (front and rear pair)
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 310 g for the complete front/rear BR-5000-49 pair with factory brake pads and sunken pivot bolts; 39–49 mm reach. This is the explicitly specified recessed-mount reference, not the optional standard-pivot-bolt variant.
